introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Geology (0555), Paper 2, ORDINARY LEVEL, JUNE 2024. Duration: Two and a Half Hours.**

Instructions to candidates: Answer FIVE questions: choosing TWO questions from Section A, TWO from Section B and question 7 in Section C. (Note: Question 7 is compulsory.)

You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers.

regles_choix.texte: Question 7 is compulsory: every candidate answers it.

incertitudes: Aucun corrigé officiel : les réponses modèles sont rédigées d'après les notions classiques du programme O Level de Géologie ; elles sont à faire relire par un géologue avant mise en avant. Le sujet est une feuille à compléter (lignes pointillées) : les lignes ne sont pas reproduites.

Règles de choix : page de garde « Answer FIVE questions: choosing TWO questions from section A, TWO from section B and question 7 in Section C. (Note: Question 7 is compulsory) ». Question 4(c) : la liste de minéraux exploités au Cameroun est donnée en valeurs de cours (or, diamant, bauxite, rutile, cassitérite, calcaire) ; aucune localisation ni production n'est affirmée.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) (i) List any TWO plates that were formed when Gondwanaland split.

(2 marks)

(ii) State TWO characteristics of convergent plate boundaries.

(2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i)** Any two of: the **South American** plate, the **African** plate, the **Indian** (Indo-Australian) plate, the **Antarctic** plate, the **Australian** plate.

**(ii)** Any two of:

1. Two plates **move towards each other** (collide).
2. Where an oceanic plate meets a continental plate, the denser oceanic plate is **subducted**, forming an ocean trench; crust is destroyed.
3. They produce **fold mountains** (continental-continental collision) or **volcanic arcs**.
4. Strong, deep-focus **earthquakes** and volcanic activity occur along them.
themes: plate tectonics and sea floor spreading

questions.enonce_markdown:
(b) (i) Define the term geologic hazard.

(2 marks)

(ii) Name TWO greenhouse gases.

(2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i)** A **geologic hazard** is a natural geological process or event (such as an earthquake, volcanic eruption, landslide, flood or tsunami) that is dangerous to human life, property and the environment.

**(ii)** Any two of: **carbon dioxide** ($\mathrm{CO_2}$), **methane** ($\mathrm{CH_4}$), nitrous oxide ($\mathrm{N_2O}$), water vapour, chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs).

questions.enonce_markdown:
(c) List TWO minerals mined in Cameroon.

(2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: Any two of: **gold**, **diamond**, **bauxite**, **rutile**, **cassiterite** (tin ore), **limestone** (for cement), iron ore.
